candidate_laws.note: r_comp = w_MX r_M25 + (1-w_MX) r_T25 with r from F4d at 800 C (T25 ~17, M25 ~88 wt.%). Pure and composite curves are different samples on the same panel (split nodes => disjoint M roots). Authors give 73.8 vs 76 wt.% for T5@M20 in text (contamination for that cell); T20@M5, T15@M10, T10@M15 unprinted -> read from curve.

candidate_laws.family: thin-film shielding (Colaneri-Shacklette SE = 20 log10(1 + Z0 sigma t / 2)), ranking only
candidate_laws.note: Quantitatively off (M25: predicted ~62 dB vs 30.7 measured), so ranking only (spread set >20%). sigma*t increases monotonically T20@M5..M25 as does SE_T. RISK: Methods says 'The EMI SE was calculated according to the Simon formula' - if SE_T is read as computed from sigma this law becomes definitional; resolve before use. sigma and thickness both from Table 2 / F6a.
T4 audit: 100(1-10^(-SE_T/10)) from F7a/F7d; Table 2 prints both (answers readable).
density not reported -> only implied density can be audited; weak.

candidate_laws.family: additivity of SE with thickness (SE_T proportional to layer count)

mechanisms: TOCNF intercalation into MXene interlayers (expanded d002)
no intercalation: physical mixing / phase-separated stacking of restacked MXene
t5_pairs.authors_span: This crystallographic evolution provides compelling evidence that the 1D high aspect ratio TOCNFs are effectively intercalated into the 2D MXene interlayers.

observables.direction_B: no shift (002 stays at the M25 position)

mechanisms: interfacial hydrogen-bond network between TOCNF -OH/-COOH and MXene terminations
t5_pairs.authors_span: This phenomenon confirms that a robust intermolecular hydrogen-bonding network is formed between the hydroxyl/carboxyl groups on TOCNFs chains and the terminal functional groups on the MXene surface.

observables.name: -OH stretching band position, T5@M20 vs T25

mechanisms: thickness lowers input impedance -> stronger impedance mismatch -> SE_R grows with laminated thickness
reflection is a front-surface property (SE_R set by surface impedance/conductivity, independent of thickness once t >> skin depth)

t5_pairs.authors_span: This exacerbates the impedance mismatch between the hybrid films and the free space $\left( \sim 3 7 7 \Omega \right)$ , resulting in stronger surface reflection.

observables.name: SE_R vs number of laminated layers
observables.direction_B: no change with layer count (only SE_A grows)

risks: Tables 1-3 print nearly every plotted value (conductivity, SE_T/SE_A/SE_R, SSE/t, efficiency, thickness, folding, strength) - answers readable from text
Methods says 'The EMI SE was calculated according to the Simon formula' while also giving the S-parameter equations: SE level M vs A(sigma) ambiguous; thin-film/Simon law may be definitional
EMI panels exclude T25 and mechanical panels exclude M25: no plot panel covers all 6 conditions except F3, F4a/b/d/e, F6a
F5a caption says T5@M20, text says T20@M5
TGA mixing law is the only independent quantitative law; authors print the T5@M20 cell (73.8 vs 76 wt.%)
density used for SSE/t not described in Methods
